products.name: Marine Flower Peptide Lip Serum
products.tagline: Silky serum for smoother, plumper lips. Improves fine lines, adds moisture and helps skin look firm. Wear alone or layer for an added boost.
products.description: Ready, set, plump. Reach for this silky serum to reveal smoother, plumper-looking lips while improving the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles in the lips and surrounding area. Wear on its own or try layering it under your favorite lip balm or lipstick for an added boost.
products.howToUse: Gently depress the finger trigger nozzle to dispense a small amount of product and use the oval tip applicator to massage the serum into lips and surrounding area. Use as often as needed. Leave on.

products.name: Lip Trio
products.tagline: Combat dry lips with this 3-step treatment. Fruit enzymes, hydrating mask and minty balm for refined, deeply hydrated and plumped lips.
products.description:
Erase the appearance of winter dryness and treat your lips to a naturally effective three-step treatment. Gentle fruit enzymes refine the lip area, followed by an extra rich masque that deeply hydrates. Finish with a delicious minty non-petroleum based take-home balm that stimulates lip-plumping collagen. 

Step 1: Citrus Enzyme Lip Exfoliator 

Effective citrus and pineapple enzymes refine the lip area removing the appearance of dryness and the look of fine lip lines. Potent fruit pulp infuses bioflavonoids and vitamins to parched lips leaving them smooth and ready for the next step.
products.howToUse:
CITRUS ENZYME LIP EXFOLIATOR - STEP 1 

Remove lipstick or foundation from lip surface and outline areas. Apply a thin layer of Exfoliant to lip surface and outline. Leave on for 5 minutes. Remove with a damp sponge, then blot with tissue or clean towel. Follow with STEP 2. 

LIP COMFORT PLUMPING MASQUE - STEP 2 

Following the lip exfoliation (STEP 1), apply a layer of the masque to the lip surface and outline. Leave on for 5 minutes. Remove with a damp sponge, then blot with a tissue or a clean towel. Follow with the Eminence Citrus Lip Balm for best results (STEP 3). 

CITRUS LIP BALM - STEP 3 

Apply to the lips at the last stage of the three step treatment.

benefits.outcome: The appearance of fine vertical lines around lip area are diminished
